description: On the green bed sheet in front of you are two small white square pieces and a white rounded peg-like part, with a dark pillow against the back. The left hand slides in to steady the stacked square pieces while the right hand reaches in, grasps the rounded part as a right-hand object, lifts it up, and then lowers and seats it onto the top square, making small adjustments as the left hand keeps the base from shifting.
